name: @devscholar/pyodide-tk
description: Tcl/Tk + em-x11 + _tkinter as Pyodide-loadable side modules. Lets unmodified Python tkinter programs run in the browser.

scripts.postinstall:
bash scripts/setup.sh && printf '
>> Run "pnpm build" to compile pyodide-tk, then "pnpm dev" to start.

'
scripts.build: pnpm run build:native && pnpm run stage-assets && pnpm run build:web
